title: 2005 HMMT February Team Round 2 Problem 5
statement: Prove that an \(m \times n\) rectangle is ( \(0, b\) )-tileable if and only if \(2 b \mid m\) or \(2 b \mid n\).

solutions.text: It is easy to exhibit a tiling of such a rectangle. The other direction follows from below. (It is also possible to prove this using a coloring argument as above: starting in one corner, divide the board into \(b \times b\) blocks and color them checkerboard fashion. The details are left to the reader.)
